summary: Iteration 295 — Logo Upload + Markdown/HTML Header/Footer for Invoice Templates: All features tested and working correctly. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (1 rate-limit error during batch run, passed on retry). Frontend: All UI components verified and functional including Logo section, Format selectors, and placeholder text changes.
critical_code_review_comments: Logo Upload: POST /api/admin/invoice-templates/{id}/logo correctly validates file size (max 2MB) and MIME type (PNG/JPG/SVG/WebP)
Logo GET: Returns image with correct Content-Type header, 404 if no logo exists
Logo DELETE: Removes logo_storage_path from template, subsequent GET returns 404
Header/Footer Format: PUT endpoint correctly saves header_format and footer_format fields (text/markdown/html)
PDF Generation: Logo is embedded at top of PDF, markdown/html header/footer rendered correctly via _render_rich_text()
_render_rich_text: Markdown **bold** → , HTML drops block tags but keeps //, Text escapes HTML and converts newlines to
Template List: logo_storage_path field included in GET /api/admin/invoice-templates response
Invoice Snapshot: logo_storage_path, logo_content_type, header_format, footer_format all captured in invoice snapshot for PDF generation
Frontend Logo Section: Preview box with placeholder icon, 'Hochladen'/'Ersetzen' button text based on logo presence, 'Entfernen' button when logo exists
Frontend Upload Button: Correctly disabled when creating NEW template (no template_id yet), enabled when editing existing template
Frontend Format Selectors: Dropdown with Text/Markdown/HTML options for both Kopfzeile (header) and Fußzeile (footer)
Frontend Placeholder Text: Changes based on format selection - Markdown shows '**Fett**, *Kursiv*, [Link](https://…)', HTML shows 'Fett Akzent'
seed_data_creation: Test templates created during testing with TEST_ prefix - cleanup fixture removes them automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 295 fully tested. Key findings: (1) Logo upload works via multipart POST to /api/admin/invoice-templates/{id}/logo, (2) File validation: max 2MB, allowed MIME types: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/svg+xml, (3) Logo stored in Object Storage at meetflow/invoice-templates/{id}/logo.{ext}, (4) Header/footer format saved as 'text', 'markdown', or 'html' in template, (5) PDF generation uses _render_rich_text() to convert markdown/html to ReportLab-safe HTML, (6) Frontend shows Logo section in template editor with preview box, upload/replace/remove buttons, (7) Format selectors are dropdowns with 3 options, placeholder text in textarea changes based on selection, (8) Upload button disabled for new templates (must save first to get template_id), (9) Templates table has Logo column showing thumbnail or placeholder icon.
